summary: MarketAxess filed an 8-K updating the regulatory timetable for its pending merger with Intercontinental Exchange. The parties refiled HSR notifications on September 29, 2026, after voluntarily withdrawing them on September 25, 2026, to give the DOJ more review time. The HSR waiting period now expires October 29, 2026, subject to early termination, extension, or a second request. A MarketAxess special stockholder meeting is set for October 29, 2026, to vote on adopting the merger agreement. Closing is expected in the first half of 2027, pending antitrust clearance and stockholder approval.
